Class VolumeRenderer

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.spatial.VolumeRenderer
public class VolumeRenderer extends Object
Renders an ImageJ stack as a volume with a 3D texture. The volume is drawn with slices along the axis which is most aligned with the view direction (back to front). The color of a voxel is the color of the LUT (or gray) and the alpha value the intensity (scaled to the display range of the image). Opacity and threshold are applied while rendering. The colors, the size of the texture and the stack are applied when a stack is loaded!

  • Method Details

    • load

      public boolean load(ij.ImagePlus imp)
      Loads a stack (the current channel and frame of a hyperstack) as a volume. Must be called again if the stack, the LUT or the display range have been changed!
      Parameters:
      imp - the ImageJ image
      Returns:
      true if the stack has been loaded

    • reload

      public boolean reload()
      Loads the last loaded stack again (e.g., after a LUT change).
      Returns:
      true if the stack has been loaded

    • setTransferFunction

      public void setTransferFunction(com.eco.bio7.spatial.TransferFunction tf)
      Sets a transfer function for the colors and the opacities of the voxels (the intensity 0 - 255 is the position 0 - 1 of the function, the display range of the stack). null uses the colors of the LUT and the intensity as opacity. The texture is created again (the stack is not loaded again).
      Parameters:
      tf - the transfer function (copied) or null

    • setClipping

      public void setClipping(Clipping clipping)
      Sets the clipping with the mask of the removed voxels (see Clipping.cutRoi and Clipping.setMask). The texture is created again after a change of the mask.
      Parameters:
      clipping - the clipping or null

    • setSelection

      public void setSelection(ValueSelection selection)
      Sets the values of the stack which are displayed (used by the next load, a loaded stack is loaded again): ValueSelection.ALL (the default), ValueSelection.IMAGE_THRESHOLD (the values in the threshold of the image in ImageJ, e.g., only the particles), a range of values (ValueSelection.range) or the labels of a segmentation (ValueSelection.labels). The other voxels are transparent.
      Parameters:
      selection - the selection (null = all values)

    • renderSlice

      public void renderSlice(com.jogamp.opengl.GL2 gl, boolean cartesian, List<double[]> polygon)
      Renders a cross-section of the volume (an opaque polygon with the colors of the voxels, e.g., the cutting plane of Clipping). Empty voxels (below the threshold) are not drawn. The volume does not need to be displayed (see setShow).
      Parameters:
      gl - the OpenGL context
      cartesian - true for the Cartesian mode
      polygon - the corners of the polygon (scene coordinates)
